::: {.report-lead}

### Population Structure {#gwas-pdf-population-structure}

PCA is computed on the LD-pruned marker set; the kinship matrix is the cohort-wide GEMMA centered K (`-gk 1`). Block-wise high K is expected for selfing/inbreeding panels.

:::

```{python}
#| label: pdf-fig-gwas-pca
#| output: asis
pca_path = resolve('pca_eigenvec_file')
if pca_path and os.path.exists(pca_path):
    show_figure(plot_pca(pca_path))
else:
    display(Markdown('PCA results missing (population_structure module disabled or artifacts absent); section skipped.'))
```

```{python}
#| label: pdf-fig-gwas-kinship
#| output: asis
kinship_path = resolve('kinship_matrix_file')
if kinship_path and os.path.exists(kinship_path):
    show_figure(plot_kinship_heatmap(
        kinship_path,
        max_samples=int(kinship_settings.get('heatmap_max_samples', 194)),
    ))
else:
    display(Markdown('Kinship matrix missing (kinship_analysis module disabled or artifacts absent); section skipped.'))
```
